07 · a little letter

just for you.

FOR JOYA ❤tap to open

Joya,

You never let me finish a serious sentence — teasing your way out of it every single time. So I built you something you couldn't answer with a joke. At least not for a few minutes.

You're the girl in the orchard, the one in the yellow shirt laughing at nothing, the loud comedian in that chat, and the woman I can't stop looking at now — all still you, all at once. I don't think I'll ever get tired of finding out who you're turning into next.

Thank you for staying, even when I'm not serious. Especially then.

— always, from the one who never wins the ragebait
